tasks.name: משלים ל-15
tasks.note: Returns the 4-bit complement 15 minus a.

tasks.name: פי שלוש
tasks.note: Triples a and keeps the low four bits.

tasks.name: הגדול מבין שניים
tasks.note: Returns the larger of the two inputs.

tasks.name: איחוד ביטים
tasks.note: Returns the bitwise OR of the two inputs.

tasks.name: חצי
tasks.note: Halves a, rounding down.

tasks.name: קסור
tasks.note: Returns the bitwise XOR of the two inputs.

tasks.name: מקסימום שלושה
tasks.note: Returns the largest of three inputs.

tasks.name: שארית שלוש
tasks.note: Returns a modulo 3.

tasks.name: שווים?
tasks.note: Flags 15 when both inputs are equal, else 0.

tasks.name: סכום מוגבל
tasks.note: Adds the inputs, saturating at 15.

tasks.name: ריבוע מודולו
tasks.note: Squares a and keeps the low four bits.

tasks.name: מפת אוהל
tasks.note: Tent map: doubles a below 8, otherwise folds it back down from the top.

tasks.name: חילוף חצאי ביטים
tasks.note: Swaps the low and high two-bit halves of a.

tasks.name: ממוצע
tasks.note: Returns the floor of the average of the two inputs.

tasks.name: שארית מוזזת
tasks.note: Returns a modulo b plus one.

tasks.name: כיבוי ביטים
tasks.note: Clears in a every bit that is set in b.

tasks.name: סכום מודולו
tasks.note: Returns a plus b modulo c plus one.

tasks.name: ממוצע שלושה
tasks.note: Returns the floor of the mean of three inputs.

tasks.name: זוגיים בשלישייה
tasks.note: Counts how many of the three inputs are even.

tasks.name: הכנסת ביט
tasks.note: Shifts a left by one and shifts in the low bit of b.

tasks.name: מכפלה מודולו
tasks.note: Multiplies the inputs modulo 16.

tasks.name: משולשי מודולו
tasks.note: Returns the a-th triangular number modulo 16.

tasks.name: עליות
tasks.note: Counts the strict rises from a to b and from b to c.

tasks.name: אפסים בסוף
tasks.src: a=>{ if(!a) return 4; let n=0; while(!(a&1)){ a>>=1; n++; } return n; }
tasks.note: Counts trailing zero bits of a, with 4 for zero.

tasks.name: צעדי קולץ
tasks.src: a=>{ let n=0; while(a>1){ a=a&1?3*a+1:a/2; n++; } return Math.min(n,15); }
tasks.note: Counts Collatz steps from a down to 1, capped at 15.

tasks.name: מחלקים משותפים
tasks.src: (a,b)=>{ let c=0; for(let d=1;d<=Math.min(a,b);d++) if(a%d===0&&b%d===0) c++; return c; }
tasks.note: Counts the common divisors of the inputs, with 0 when either is zero.

tasks.name: כפולות 3 בטווח
tasks.src: (a,b)=>{ let c=0; for(let x=a;x<=b;x++) if(x%3===0) c++; return c; }
tasks.note: Counts multiples of three in the closed range from a to b.

tasks.name: צעדים במעגל
tasks.src: (a,b,c)=>{ for(let k=0;k<16;k++) if(((a+k*c)&15)===b) return k; return 15; }
tasks.note: Counts steps of size c modulo 16 needed to go from a to b, or 15 if never reached.

tasks.name: סכום מחלקים
tasks.src: a=>{ let s=0; for(let d=1;d<a;d++) if(a%d===0) s+=d; return s&15; }
tasks.note: Sums the proper divisors of a modulo 16.

tasks.name: ביטים משותפים
tasks.src: (a,b)=>{ let x=a&b, c=0; while(x){ c+=x&1; x>>=1; } return c; }
tasks.note: Counts the bits set in both inputs.

tasks.name: מרחק מלך
tasks.note: Returns king-move distance between two cells of a 4x4 grid.

tasks.name: חזקה מודולרית
tasks.src: (a,b,c)=>{ if(!c) return 0; let r=1%c; for(let i=0;i<b;i++) r=(r*a)%c; return r; }
tasks.note: Computes a to the power b modulo c, or 0 when c is zero.

tasks.name: מקדם בינומי
tasks.src: (a,b)=>{ if(b>a) return 0; let r=1; for(let i=0;i<b;i++) r=r*(a-i)/(i+1); return Math.min(15,r); }
tasks.note: Returns a choose b capped at 15.

tasks.name: מנה עליונה
tasks.note: Returns ceiling of b divided by a capped at 15, or 15 when a is zero.
